description: Human-reviewed highest validated upstream agent version per hook connector x OS. The live connector E2E workflow (.github/workflows/connector-live-e2e.yml) only REPORTS the version it ran against and opens a connector-regression issue on a live-cell failure — it never edits this file. A maintainer updates last_validated_version here (and, when raising/lowering a support floor/ceiling, hook_contracts.json + internal/gateway/connector/hook_contract.go) after reviewing a green run. 'os' keys are linux, macos, windows; an empty last_validated_version means 'not yet certified'.

copilot.notes: Native Windows implementation is present but not certified; official-client Windows evidence remains pending.

hermes.notes: contract-only (Layer A); the identical exact 23-event shell-hook set and pre_tool_call response semantics were source-verified at official Hermes Agent tags v2026.7.20 (0.19.0), v2026.7.30 (0.19.1), and v2026.8.3 (0.20.0), bounded to <0.21.0. Packaged and real-client Windows validation remains pending.

windsurf.notes: legacy Cascade-only contract (Layer A); preview/not certified. Devin Local (the current default), its separate lifecycle hooks, cloud, ACP, and managed/ProgramData layers are unsupported and unverified; no real-client evidence is recorded.

opencode.notes: Source-reviewed contract is pinned to OpenCode 1.18.11 (reviewed range >=1.18.10,<1.18.12); the relevant 1.18.11 plugin/runtime files are byte-identical to 1.18.10. Native Windows implementation remains preview/not_certified with live=false; authentic packaged Setup and official-client certification evidence remain pending.

antigravity.notes: Native Windows x64 implementation and contract checks are present but certification remains pending integrated packaged and official-client validation. The vendor updater manifest and official release page reported CLI 1.1.9 on 2026-07-31; that is availability metadata only and is not a validation record. The current manual delta confirms only public not_certified gate rejection; no protected-client, authentication, or client-provenance test occurred, and shared readiness remains integration-owned. Enterprise/managed, Team, ProgramData, cloud-dashboard, MDM, and organization-policy surfaces remain out of scope and unverified. Real official-client E2E is manual on a dedicated pre-authenticated Windows runner because Google documents Windows Credential Manager/browser auth, not API-key bootstrap.

omnigent.notes: contract-only; native Windows server/SDK policy bridge is degraded preview and its official-client job remains advisory
